items.title: Ran Blake interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 16, 2021
items.q: I’m recalling Bill Evans with Perry and his brother in the Berkshires

ctx.x: Yeah. It’s about 7-1/2 minutes and I have a couple of questions about it. As you play it do you know where you’re going from one moment to the next?

I do a lot of dress rehearsals away from the piano, and I often conceive the beginning, in fact I’m rusty at this piece now, I haven’t heard my interpretation, but I think I usually have my ear to guide me and sometimes I think of plot summaries and I’m recalling Bill Evans with Perry and his brother in the Berkshires, the Lenox School of Jazz, where I studied with Bill and Oscar. So I think up, I think I do but sometimes I’m not sure I’m the one to answer. Yes I think, but many free players, I’m very pleased you…

You will be adding a nice element to our collection. And I’m wondering as you play a piece like that, or your own compositions, and you’re sort of in the middle of it, do you ever surprise yourself by where your hands go and the sounds that are created?
